items.description: Fetches Tongfudun LegionClaw usage-permission invite codes by POSTing JSON with userId set to the agentid (second colon-delimited segment) parsed from a LegionClaw session handle. Obtain the session handle from runtime injection or by querying the LegionClaw host or model; do not default to asking the user to paste it. Use when the user needs Tongfudun LegionClaw access invite codes, asks for fetch-legionclaw-invite-code, or says things like 邀请码, 要邀请码, 获取邀请码, 申请邀请码, 生成邀请码, 给我邀请码, 帮我生成邀请码, 发我邀请码, 多个邀请码, LegionClaw 邀请码, 通付盾邀请码, or LegionClaw 使用权限.

Initial release: Polymarket paper trading and simulation skill for PaperBook

- Build, paper-trade, and honestly backtest Polymarket-style bots using PaperBook (paperclob.com), a wire-compatible, paper-money CLOB and honest simulator based on real Polymarket order books.
- Integrates quickly by fetching the always-current API contract from /llms-full.txt before coding.
- Supports two modes: live paper trading in a CLOB environment and private honest simulations replaying real market history.
- Simulator enforces honest fills and grades strategies with a transparent, citation-ready verdict; strategies are judged by realized vs. fillable edge, not by naive paper performance.
- Designed for users building/testing bots, paper trading, backtesting prediction market strategies, or experimenting with py-clob-client in a safe, realistic environment.

latestVersion.changelog:
alibabacloud-waf-rule-management v0.0.1 – Initial public release with major compliance-focused improvements:

- Enforced strict read-only mode: all write/configure/modify operations and script output are explicitly forbidden.
- Introduced session-based User-Agent tracking: every CLI call must use a unique session ID per workflow.
- Enhanced CLI and SLS plugin setup guidance, including postpay/subscription logstore naming and region handling.
- Expanded and clarified pre-checklists, command traps, and absolute prohibitions to protect credentials and prevent misconfiguration.
- Updated documentation for compliance, including mandatory disclaimer and precise audit guidance for all outputs.
- Removed obsolete files; focused all logic/documentation on secure, text-based guidance and diagnostic analysis only.
